court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Judicial Magistrate First Class, Kopargaon, Dist.Ahmednagar, Regular Criminal Case No.43 of 2022
case_name: Ganesh Madhukar Gadekar And Others v. The State Of Maharashtra And Another

parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra and another

facts_of_case: Couple seeks to quash criminal case for offenses punishable under Sections 498A, 504 and 506. They have agreed to amicably settle all disputes and seek divorce.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to demonstrate that the proceedings are abuse of process.
legal_principles.held: They, therefore, unanimously request for quashment of the crime and the criminal case.
cited_cases: Ganesh Madhukar Gadekar And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another, (2022)

legal_principles.principle: The court may quash criminal proceedings if the parties have amicably settled their disputes.
legal_principles.held: They advert our attention to the application Exhibit-F to demonstrate that they have inter alia agreed to withdraw all the proceedings initiated by them against each other including the present crime.
cited_cases: Ganesh Madhukar Gadekar And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another, (2022)

outcome.final_order: FIR No.0005 of 2022 registered at Kopargaon Rural Police Station, Dist.Ahmednagar, are quashed and set aside.
